QUOTE: An empty answer for a name in those files is then reported as "this file type was not indexed here", which points the caller to read the file directly.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that without the grammars the front ends register nothing, routing to an absent grammar returns "no grammar" instead of raising, and those file types are reported as not indexed. That is degradation rather than failure, and the substrate gate is named. The answer also names the per-route check in `harvest.py`, but not the router consulting the gate itself.
